---
title: "Discard raising explorer"
author: "Damian Villagra"
output: html_document
---

Interactive front-end for `discard_raising_functions.R`. Two tabs, one stock at
a time: **Coverage** (where sampling is present / missing) and **Raising ladder**
(assign donor discard rates to under-sampled strata, fine → coarse, with a live
donor trace).

**How to run:** run `setup`, `helpers`, `ui`, `server` once, then the final
`run-app` chunk to (re)launch. A `census` (or `catch_data`) object in the session
is used automatically if no file is uploaded; it is `prep_census()`-ed on the fly.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(shiny); library(DT); library(dplyr); library(ggplot2)

# Source the analysis functions (kept separate). Adjust the path if needed.
fn <- if (requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE) &&
          file.exists(here::here("discard_raising_functions.R")))
  here::here("discard_raising_functions.R") else "discard_raising_functions.R"
source(fn)

options(shiny.maxRequestSize = 200 * 1024^2)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r helpers}
# friendly dimension labels -> data columns (Fleet resolves to the chosen level)
DIM_COLS <- c(Country = "vesselFlagCountry", Area = "areaValue", Season = "seasonValue")

read_catch_file <- function(path, name) {
  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(name))
  df <- switch(ext,
    rds  = readRDS(path),
    csv  = readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE),
    tsv  = readr::read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE),
    txt  = readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE),
    xls  = , xlsx = {
      if (!requireNamespace("readxl", quietly = TRUE))
        stop("Install 'readxl' to read Excel files.")
      readxl::read_excel(path)
    },
    stop("Unsupported file type: .", ext))
  as.data.frame(df)
}
```

```{r ui}
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Discard raising explorer"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(

      fileInput("file", "Catch data (.rds / .csv / .xlsx)",

      checkboxInput("use_session", "Use census / catch_data from session", TRUE),
      uiOutput("stock_ui"),

                  c("Metier_L4", "Metier_L5", "Metier_L6", "mesh_size", "fleetValue")),
      tags$hr(),
      conditionalPanel(
        "input.tabs == 'Raising ladder'",

        helpText("Base = fleet level (always grouped). Pick refinement dims in the",

        selectizeInput("ladder_dims", "Refinement dims (finest \u2192 drop order)",
                       choices = names(DIM_COLS), multiple = TRUE,
                       selected = c("areaValue", "seasonValue", "vesselFlagCountry") |>
                         (\(x) names(DIM_COLS)[match(x, DIM_COLS)])()),
        numericInput("ladder_cov_thr", "Donor coverage threshold (%)", 50, 0, 100, 5),
        radioButtons("avail_metric", "Rung availability metric",
                     c("Donor discard weight" = "discards",

        uiOutput("rung_thresholds"),
        numericInput("outlier_dr", "Exclude donors with DR > (%) [blank = off]", NA, 0, 100),
        radioButtons("raising_var", "Raising weight",
                     c("Landings CATON" = "landings", "Effort (needs column)" = "effort")),
        actionButton("run_ladder", "Compute raising", class = "btn-primary")
      ),
      conditionalPanel(
        "input.tabs == 'Coverage'",
        h4("Coverage layout"),
        selectInput("cov_x", "x axis", c("Season", "Area", "Country", "Fleet"), "Season"),
        selectInput("cov_y", "y axis", c("Fleet", "Country", "Area", "Season"), "Fleet"),
        selectInput("cov_facet", "facet by", c("None", "Area", "Country", "Season", "Fleet"), "Area"),
        numericInput("cov_thr", "Coverage threshold (%)", 30, 0, 100, 5)
      )
    ),
    mainPanel(
      width = 9,
      tabsetPanel(
        id = "tabs",
        tabPanel("Coverage",
                 plotOutput("cov_heat", height = "520px"),
                 plotOutput("cov_bubble", height = "460px"),
                 h4("Gap table (not SAFE)"), DTOutput("cov_gap")),
        tabPanel("Raising ladder",
                 verbatimTextOutput("ladder_summary"),
                 plotOutput("ladder_plot", height = "560px"),
                 h4("Assignments"),    DTOutput("ladder_assign"),
                 h4("Donor trace (strata used to raise)"), DTOutput("ladder_trace"))
      )
    )
  )
)
```

```{r server}
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  census_data <- reactive({
    if (!is.null(input$file)) {
      df <- read_catch_file(input$file$datapath, input$file$name)
    } else if (isTRUE(input$use_session) && exists("census", envir = globalenv())) {
      df <- get("census", envir = globalenv())
    } else if (isTRUE(input$use_session) && exists("catch_data", envir = globalenv())) {
      df <- get("catch_data", envir = globalenv())
    } else return(NULL)
    if (!"cat_std" %in% names(df)) df <- prep_census(df)
    df
  })

  output$stock_ui <- renderUI({
    d <- census_data(); req(d)
    selectInput("stock_sel", "Stock", choices = sort(unique(as.character(d$stock))))
  })

  # friendly label -> column (Fleet uses the chosen métier level)
  col_of <- function(x) switch(x,
    Fleet = input$fleet_level, Country = "vesselFlagCountry",
    Area = "areaValue", Season = "seasonValue", x)

  # ---- Coverage tab -------------------------------------------------------
  cov_res <- reactive({
    d <- census_data(); req(d, input$stock_sel)
    diagnose_coverage(
      d, stock = input$stock_sel, fleet_level = input$fleet_level,
      x_var = col_of(input$cov_x), y_var = col_of(input$cov_y),
      facet_var = if (input$cov_facet == "None") NULL else col_of(input$cov_facet),
      coverage_threshold = input$cov_thr)
  })
  output$cov_heat   <- renderPlot(cov_res()$heatmap)
  output$cov_bubble <- renderPlot(cov_res()$bubbles)
  output$cov_gap    <- renderDT(datatable(cov_res()$gap_table, rownames = FALSE,
                                          options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)))

  # ---- Ladder construction (base + peeled refinement dims) ---------------
  ladder_keys <- reactive({
    base <- input$fleet_level
    ref  <- unname(DIM_COLS[input$ladder_dims %||% character(0)])  # in drop order
    rungs <- list(c(base, ref))                                   # finest
    if (length(ref))
      for (j in seq_along(ref)) rungs[[j + 1]] <- c(base, ref[-(seq_len(j))])
    rungs
  })

  output$rung_thresholds <- renderUI({
    rungs <- ladder_keys(); req(rungs)
    tagList(lapply(seq_along(rungs), function(i)
      numericInput(paste0("thr_", i),
                   paste0("Rung ", i, " min avail — ", paste(rungs[[i]], collapse = " + ")),
                   value = 0, min = 0)))
  })

  thr_vec <- reactive({
    rungs <- ladder_keys()
    vapply(seq_along(rungs), function(i) {
      v <- input[[paste0("thr_", i)]]; if (is.null(v) || is.na(v)) 0 else v
    }, numeric(1))
  })
  outlier <- reactive({ v <- input$outlier_dr; if (is.null(v) || is.na(v)) NULL else v })

  ladder_res <- eventReactive(input$run_ladder, {
    d <- census_data(); req(d, input$stock_sel)
    raise_discards_ladder(
      d, stock = input$stock_sel, ladder = ladder_keys(),
      coverage_threshold = input$ladder_cov_thr, avail_thresholds = thr_vec(),
      avail_metric = input$avail_metric, outlier_dr = outlier(),
      raising_var = input$raising_var)
  })

  output$ladder_summary <- renderText({
    res <- ladder_res(); req(res)
    a <- res$assignments
    n_unassigned <- sum(a$used_keys == "UNASSIGNED")
    n_self <- sum(res$strata$role == "self", na.rm = TRUE)
    sprintf(paste0("self (kept): %d   |   raised: %d   |   unassigned: %d   |   ",
                   "estimated raised discards: %.1f"),
            n_self, nrow(a) - n_unassigned, n_unassigned,
            sum(a$est_discards, na.rm = TRUE))
  })
  output$ladder_plot   <- renderPlot(ladder_res()$plot)
  output$ladder_assign <- renderDT(datatable(ladder_res()$assignments, rownames = FALSE,
                                             options = list(pageLength = 12, scrollX = TRUE)) |>
                                    formatRound(c("landings","coverage_pct","raise_w",
                                                  "donor_avail","dr_used","est_discards"), 2))
  output$ladder_trace  <- renderDT({
    tr <- ladder_res()$donor_trace
    if (!nrow(tr)) return(datatable(data.frame(note = "No donors used")))
    datatable(tr, rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 12, scrollX = TRUE))
  })
}
```

```{r run-app, eval=FALSE}
# Run this chunk to (re)launch the app.
shinyApp(ui, server)
```
